The '''Imperial Firebase 3''' was a [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] base located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum's]] [[Western Ice Shelf]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
The base was used by the Sith Empire during the fighting against [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces that followed the return of the ancient [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' on Ilum. Gree vendors [[Trikat'k]] and [[Zilok'k]] operated in this base, as well as numerous Gree [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].<ref name="TOR" />
